title: What happens to price when demand rises?

steps.title: Supply and Demand
steps.say: Let's look at a standard market with downward-sloping demand and upward-sloping supply.

ops.text: What happens to price when demand rises?

steps.title: Demand Increases
steps.say: When demand rises, consumers want to buy more at every price, shifting the entire demand curve to the right.

steps.title: New Equilibrium
steps.say: The new equilibrium moves up along the supply curve, resulting in both a higher price and a higher quantity.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.say: Now try dragging the curves yourself to see how shifting demand or supply changes the market equilibrium.
